assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production-ready individual character bust PNG for the approved Madness atelier interface, usable both as a small circular portrait via CSS and as a larger agent information card.
Input images: Image 1 is the APPROVED ORIGINAL CASTING identity reference. Image 2 is the APPROVED ATELIER visual-style reference, not a layout to reproduce.
Primary request: create ONLY MARY, the first person at the far left of Image 1, as a single isolated head-and-shoulders-and-upper-torso bust on a genuinely transparent background.
Identity invariants: preserve Mary's warm medium-brown skin, expressive dark almond eyes, arched brows, friendly intelligent slightly asymmetrical closed-mouth smile, beauty mark, short voluminous tightly curly dark-brown bob with the same side-swept silhouette, small gold hoop earrings, blue-petrol high-collared workshop coat, charcoal inner top, ochre-brown shoulder strap, small copper/terracotta workshop details. Follow the close-up of Mary at the lower left of Image 1; do not blend in any other character.
Style/medium: match the approved original cel-shaded atelier illustration: confident dark ink outlines, angular hard-edged light and shadow, restrained painterly paper/metal wear inside the clothing, crisp facial shapes that remain readable at thumbnail size. Warm natural face light and cool petrol shadows. The same original person, never a recognizable existing Borderlands hero.
Composition/framing: square 1024 x 1024 canvas; head facing almost forward with the slight three-quarter turn and warm gaze of the casting; head, both whole shoulders and upper chest visible, arms rest below the frame, no held notebook or pencil. Centered figure at consistent bust scale: top of hair around 10% from top, chin around 52% down, complete shoulder width contained between 10% and 90% of canvas. Keep generous true-alpha empty margins around hair and shoulders, and 8% empty margin below a clean intentional lower-torso cutout silhouette. Do not crop hair or shoulders. Face is the visual focus.
Background: actual transparent alpha everywhere outside the character silhouette, no painted white/black/colored backdrop, no checkerboard painted into the image, no cast shadow behind or beneath the figure.
Constraints: one character only, no scene, no environmental props, no UI, no card frame, no label, no letters, no watermark, no halo. Preserve identity and clothing, do not redesign the approved direction.
assets.inspection: Visuellement inspecté : un personnage, identité du casting conservée, pas de texte ni décor, tête et épaules visibles.

visualReview.identity: Visages, coiffures, teints, vêtements et accessoires distinctifs comparés au casting approuvé.
visualReview.composition: Bustes isolés, tête complète, deux épaules et haut du torse visibles; découpe inférieure intentionnelle; pas de texte, cadre, décor ou autre personnage.
visualReview.smallPortraitIntent: Traits et silhouettes conçus pour un crop CSS de portrait. Aucun contrôle intégré de rendu Windows ou vignette du produit n’est revendiqué.
visualReview.alpha: Vrai canal alpha, min0/max255. Au bord extérieur, seulement quelques pixels natifs alpha1; aucun alpha>1. Alpha original conservé sans nettoyage ni retouche.
visualReview.semantics: Ces illustrations ne prouvent aucune activation, disponibilité de skill ou identité native d’agent.
